plugins.name: credit-card-spending-dashboard
plugins.description: Turn monthly credit-card statement PDFs into one self-contained offline dashboard.html plus Markdown reports. Card-count-agnostic; ships no personal data. Commands: /update-statement, /update-dashboard, /set-expiryCard, /set-cardName, /set-recurringRule, /list-cards, /set-category, /set-merchantGroup, /add-merchantToGroup, /remove-merchantFromGroup, /merge-merchantGroup, /auto-merchantGroup, /apply-userConfig, /list-category, /list-merchantGroup, /auto-categorize, /migrate.
